supplementaryReferences.doc: Mathews, Silim and Saxena: ICPN 8 (2001), Tables 1–2, printed pp37–38
supplementaryReferences.note: Malekutu, Mpumalanga, 1998/99; rainfed mid-December sowing, sandy loam, no fertiliser. Paired days after planting / grain kg/ha: ICPL 88039 127 / 1823; ICPL 85010 129 / 1525; ICPL 87091 140 / 1299; ICPL 87051 193 / 978; ICEAP 00053 231 / 918. Grain differences within each trial were not significant. Visually checked Tables 1–2 (PDF pp43–44). These are dry-grain observations, not green-seed picking dates or nationwide yield defaults.

supplementaryReferences.title: Tentative newer ARC planting comparison
supplementaryReferences.doc: Bello, Mofokeng and du Toit: SA Graan/Grain, October 2021, pp56–57
supplementaryReferences.note: Potchefstroom 2020/21, good rainfall season: ICEAP01258 versus ICEAP01284 and 22 October versus 25 November sowing. ARC tentatively favours ICEAP01284 in late October and calls for further agro-ecological trials. Exact yield values were not taken from graph bars. Confirm current seed availability; this is not a national cultivar recommendation.
